title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Monday, 14 September 2026
description: Today: a new AI chip codenamed Asimov targets 16-trillion-parameter models; a two-decade-old Australian cold case theory crumbles after a murder charge; Queensland households get an electricity price cut; and a Gold Coast fish sculpture grows way bigger than planned. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
